column3: Close to the Hebrew; “with all its furnishings” renders “and all its articles.”
“made an offering” renders “brought near”; NASB puts the description of the leaders in parentheses.
“covered carts” renders “carts of tsav,” a word whose meaning is uncertain.
“to each man according to his service” renders “each according to the mouth of his service” (also in verses 7–8).
“under the direction of” renders “in the hand of.”
“one leader each day” renders the repeated “one leader for the day, one leader for the day.”
“one gold pan” renders “one kaf (ladle),” and NASB supplies “shekels.”
“one bull” renders “one young bull, a son of the herd.”
